text:
Maria Gomez: Quick sync — I opened a docs PR for a graceful rollback playbook so product teams can flip back to v1-compatible behavior if v2 rollout causes regressions. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4892. PTAL, @Sanjeev — I copied the redirect rules and a small nginx snippet.
Sanjeev Patel: looking now. Do we also need Netlify/Cloudflare Worker examples for customers using CDN redirects? otherwise they might be stuck.
Maria Gomez: yes, added a short Cloudflare Worker snippet in the PR (at the bottom). Also added a recommended header we can inject: `x-rw-inference-deprecated: v1-fallback`.
Oliver King: small nit — can we centralize the redirects in docs/_redirects instead of scatter across guides? makes automation easier for the website pipeline.
Maria Gomez: good call. moved the sample redirect to docs/_redirects and added a short note about ordering (specific routes before catch-alls).
Harper Liu: for SDK examples: we need to update the Ruby and Go snippets to show the `model_alias` fallback param. opened companion PRs:
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/212
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/98
Can we link those from the main docs PR?
Maria Gomez: added links to the SDK PRs and called out the exact snippet lines that change. I also added a tiny smoke test command in CI that runs `yarn smoke:docs` and the snippet linter.
Sanjeev Patel: re: smoke tests — CI Bot, can you run the docs smoke-run for this branch? @CI Bot
CI Bot: CI pipeline triggered: docs-smoke/4892. Current status: queued.
Maria Gomez: Reminder: the rollback playbook includes three explicit steps for ops: 1) enable redirect, 2) flip routing policy in the gateway (example command below), 3) notify customers via status page. Example gateway command:
```
rwctl route update --route inference.prod --policy fallback:v1
```
Oliver King: Can we add a short checklist for SLO owners to measure after rollback (latency, token-cost delta, and error-rate)? we should avoid blind switches.
Maria Gomez: added a minimal SLO checklist. Also added a short template incident postmortem section to attach to the playbook so PMs can capture customer impact.
Harper Liu: one more: we should mark the top of affected pages with a short deprecation banner snippet. I added the HTML snippet in the PR (`<aside class=\"deprecation-banner\">...`).
Maria Gomez: done. final ask: who can review and approve the docs PR so we can land it before Monday deploy window? @Sanjeev? @Oliver?
Sanjeev Patel: I can approve after CI passes and smoke tests green. leaving a review now.
DocsBot: Automated note: docs lint passed for changed markdown paths. Link-checker found one broken internal link (ruby-sdk PR link) — Maria, can you patch?
Maria Gomez: fixed the link path and pushed. CI Bot: docs-smoke/4892 status: passed.
Sanjeev Patel: approved. I left inline comments about wording; nothing blocking.
Oliver King: approved too. small editorial tweaks, then ship it.
Maria Gomez: thanks everyone — rolling this into the release checklist. I'll publish a short changelog entry and ping customer-success to prepare the canned message. :thumbsup:
